title: Light Presets
description:
Fourteen one-click lighting presets in the scene lighting toolbar, working like the core wall type buttons: pick a preset, then drag to place. Grouped behind three toolbar buttons — Flame (Candle, Torch, Lantern, Bullseye Lantern, Campfire, Chimney, Lava Glow), Atmosphere (Moonlight, Fog Bank, Fey Lights, Ghostly) and Magic (Magical Glow, Divine Radiance, Magical Darkness).

Each preset fully specifies its light configuration, so switching never inherits leftover values, and its bright/dim behaviour is applied live in the drag preview. While a group is closed it carries the indicator pip if your active preset is one of its members.

Built on the V14 placeable palette system: system-agnostic, no dependencies, no external assets.
